newsitem.title: USA: L.A. mayor picks new police chief -- report.
newsitem.headline: L.A. mayor picks new police chief -- report.

text.p: - Los Angelas Mayor Richard Riordan has chosen Bernard Parks, a disciplinarian with 32 years of police experience, to be the next chief of the LAPD, the Los Angelas Times said Wednesday.

The decision is expected to be formally announced Wednesday. If confirmed by the city council, Park will become the second African American to hold the post, one of the most esteemed in American policing, the paper said.
Parks, who is seen having strong political support, would have to guide the Los Angelas Police Department as it undergoes continued reforms while expanding and fighting crime.
Parks' selection has already received the approval of the city's Police Commission. His fire-year term would extend until 2002, the paper said.
